messages:
nina: uploaded compact timeline update — main asks: disclose what 'Rewind' does, keyboard scrub behavior, and whether tiny allocation chips need labels. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-tl (frame 2).

parth: on rewind disclosure: prefer short inline rationale: 'Rewind to v12 — restores model + config'. keep it under ~35 chars so it fits in header. make the primary action 'Confirm Rewind' and the toast action 'Undo'.

sam: keyboard scrub: right now arrow keys move by 1% always. propose adaptive steps: if total allocation <=10% step=1, <=50% step=5, else step=10. expose logic via data-step attrs so tests can reference it. also add aria-roledescription="timeline scrubber" and aria-valuetext="v12, 20 percent" for SR clarity.

ivy: allocation chips in compact mode are problematic for context. two options: prefix small label 'Alloc' or add aria-label="Allocation 5 percent" while keeping visible text minimal. i prefer aria-label to avoid visual clutter. also chips need focus ring and 44px touch target.

a11y-bot: automated report:
- Missing aria-valuetext on scrub control (suggested: "{version}, {percent} percent").
- Compact allocation chips missing aria-label (8 occurrences).
- Rewind modal missing aria-describedby linking to explanation text (suggested id: rewind-explain).
- Touch target violations: interactive chip height < 44px (5 occurrences).

nina: action list:
- design: add short rewind rationale copy in modal + header, make persistent small Rewind CTA in header (nina + parth)
- eng: implement adaptive step logic + data-step attrs, add aria-valuetext and aria-roledescription (sam)
- devx: add aria-labels for compact chips and increase touch area to 44px (ivy)
- writing: confirm short header copy and toast copy variants (parth -> sam)

parth: quick copy options to review: 
1) Header: "Rewind to v12 — restores model + config"
2) Modal heading: "Confirm Rewind" body: "This will revert code, model, and traffic to v12."
3) Toast: "Rewound to v12" action: "Undo"

sam: i'll add the data-step props and wire up aria-valuetext. will leave comments in the PR for voiceover testing.

ivy: will draft the aria-label snippet for chips and post a small test plan for touch target checks.

nina: thanks — aim to have updated mocks by Fri morning. will ping when done. :sparkles:
